newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia ministers to visit India for trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia ministers to visit India for trade.

text.p: Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer and Trade Minister Tim Fischer said on Tuesday they would lead a senior ministerial team to India this month.
The trip is part of the Australia India-New Horizons programme, the ministers said in a joint statement.
"Australia and India are on the threshold of a much more productive, mutually beneficial relationship," Downer said.
Downer will launch the programme in New Delhi on October 22 and will give the keynote address on October 23. Fischer will open a major business forum on November 4.
